purpose: Patient-facing prototype safety boundaries and phrase-trigger descriptions only. This is not clinical guidance, a validated triage protocol, or an automated referral decision engine.
rules: The Naive Bayes model structures reported Bangla/Banglish/English words; it does not diagnose, prescribe, assess disease probability, or select care.
Explicit phrase-based safety checks operate separately from the classifier and may surface potential warning words.

Potential warning words include difficult breathing, seizure, unconsciousness, confusion, heavy bleeding, inability to drink or very little/no urine, chest discomfort, sudden weakness/face/speech change, concerning head injury, and pregnancy-related bleeding/labour terms.
A missing phrase match does not rule out urgency, and a match does not establish severity or a diagnosis.
For severe or life-threatening situations, seek urgent human medical care or call Bangladesh National Emergency Service 999. The app has no emergency dispatch integration.
Financial planning, community support, sharing, SMS, and app interaction must not delay urgent care.
Low uncalibrated model scores tell the patient not to rely on the AI classification and to continue with human medical assessment.

Age, duration, severity, consciousness, temperature, respiratory rate, fluid intake, urination, and pregnancy context are optional prompts where relevant; missing information is not a reason to delay urgent assessment.
Health record suggestions are never silently saved. Patient confirmation is required; a diagnosis suggestion additionally asks if a health professional diagnosed it.
Facility entries are a small sample and must be independently verified for location, opening, service, and capacity.
WHO population indicators are context only and must never be used to infer an individual diagnosis, risk, urgency, or referral.
Support, community, and financial options are illustrative. Availability and eligibility must be checked locally.
SMS, access code, mobile-money payment, connection, community request, and sync are demonstrations; no real transfer, authentication, dispatch, or transmission occurs.
